slides.title: KisanAI: Autonomous Agricultural Credit Assessment Platform

content.heading: KisanAI — AI & Satellite-Based Kisan Credit Assessment
content.subheading: Solving Agrarian Credit Underwriting via Sentinel-2 Remote Sensing & MLOps
content.presented_by: Project Group: Tanishq Kanthed, Akshat Srivastava, Radhika Yadav

key_points: Traditional Bank Inspections are Slow & Expensive: Physical field visits cost ₹5,000–₹10,000 per audit and take weeks.
High Subjectivity & Human Bias: Visual evaluations vary drastically across bank field officers.
Agrarian Debt Traps: Lenders issue credit limits based on land real-estate value rather than true biological crop yield capacity.
Static Mandi Pricing Flaw: Traditional models use static annual averages, ignoring harvest-month price drops.
Objective 1: Provide interactive GIS mapping (Leaflet + Esri) with automated polygon field area calculation in Hectares & Bigha.
Objective 2: Ingest real-time Sentinel-2 L2A satellite telemetry to assess biological vegetation health (NDVI).
Objective 3: Implement harvest-month seasonal mandi price forecasting model.
Objective 4: Synthesize satellite, weather, and soil data into a weighted risk multiplier (NDVI 45% + Weather 35% + Soil 20%).
Objective 5: Enforce a strict 60% Safe Credit Limit Cap to prevent farmer insolvency.
Objective 6: Deliver a multilingual voice-enabled AI Chatbot (Groq LLaMA 3.3 70B + RAG) for government scheme guidance.

content.frontend: React 18 + Vite 6 + TailwindCSS v4 + Leaflet.js (Web Mercator Projection)
content.backend: 100% Pure Python FastAPI (Uvicorn ASGI) — Direct ML memory execution
content.database: MongoDB BSON + Polymorphic Python In-Memory Fallback Store
content.apis_and_models: ESA Sentinel Hub v3 (Sentinel-2 L2A), Open-Meteo Weather, Groq LPU (LLaMA 3.3 70B)

content.gis_mapping: Leaflet.js + Esri World Imagery tiles (100% Free, zero Google API billing dependencies).
content.area_formula: Spherical Excess Geodesic Formula: Area = (R^2/4) * Σ (Δλ) * (2 + sin φ1 + sin φ2)
content.ndvi_formula: NDVI = (Band 8 NIR - Band 4 Red) / (Band 8 NIR + Band 4 Red)
content.caching: 7-Day JSON cache key based on 1km GPS grid resolution.

content.step_1_base_rev: Base Rev = Area (Ha) * Historical Yield (T/Ha) * 10 * Predicted Harvest Mandi Price
content.step_3_succession: Multi-Year Crop Succession Engine (e.g. Wheat -> Nitrogen-fixing Mung Bean -> Rice)
content.step_4_safe_cap: Safe Credit Cap = Total Multi-Season Combined Income * 60% (DSCR Rule)

content.price_formula: Predicted Price = Base Historical Price * Seasonal Index [C, t_harvest]
content.example: Wheat sown in November (idx=10), duration 4 months -> Harvests in March (idx=2). March Index = 1.05x -> Predicted Price = ₹3,096.98 / Quintal.
content.benefit: Reflects true market availability at harvest time instead of static annual averages.

slides.title: Government Schemes RAG & Voice AI Chatbot

content.rag_engine: Keyword/token overlap search over 7 verified government schemes (PM-KISAN, KCC, PMFBY, PM-KUSUM, etc.)
content.llm_hardware: Meta LLaMA 3.3 70B on Groq LPU (Language Processing Unit) — Sub-300ms latency (>300 tokens/sec)
content.context_prompt: Dynamic System Prompt injects Farm Profile + ML Loan Cap + RAG context to prevent hallucinations
content.voice_support: Web Speech API microphone integration with 5 regional language support

content.expansion: Pan-India Expansion: Scaling historical yield datasets beyond Maharashtra to all 28 states.
content.radar_integration: Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) integration to penetrate heavy monsoon clouds.
content.blockchain: Issuing tamper-proof, satellite-verified Credit Passport NFTs / Certificates for instant bank API verification.

content.summary: KisanAI successfully eliminates manual bank field visits by providing automated, satellite-verified credit risk evaluations in under 30 seconds.
content.impact: Protects financial institutions against bad loans while empowering smallholder farmers with fair, transparent credit limits.
